title: This Tree Ruined Christmas
text: This Tree Ruined Christmas. Garbage.  Flimsy. Not full at all after 3 hours. Embarrassing waste of money and time. I HATE this tree. All wire. And you can see every inch of wire. Bad decision. Awful tree. Sorry kids

product_metadata.title: Best Choice Products 9ft Premium Spruce Artificial Holiday Christmas Tree for Home, Office, Party Decoration w/ 2,028 Branch Tips, Easy Assembly, Metal Hinges & Foldable Base
features: CLASSIC SPRUCE TREE: Inspire holiday cheer this season with a customer favorite that helps make the season feel complete; equipped with sturdy branches, strong enough to hold garland and all your favorite ornaments for a customized look
QUALITY DESIGN: Fully fluff the branches to provide a healthy, natural appearance, with the 6-foot tree having 798 tips, 7.5-foot tree with 1,346 tips and 9-foot tree equipped with 2,028 tips
EASY ASSEMBLY & FLUFFING: Put the tree together in just 3 steps: simply connect the base to the largest section of the tree before attaching the remaining sections and easily fluffing the branches
BUILT TO LAST: Crafted with durable metal hinges and flame-retardant PVC branches that stand tall with the help of a sturdy metal base, so you can enjoy your tree for holiday seasons to come!
MANY WAYS TO DECORATE: Accentuate different areas of your living space, office, or even a holiday party by customizing your tree with garland, lights, ornaments, and more!
